changes.summary: Imported the first sub-batch of the M3 Wave 2 migration (task 4.5a) -- the no-JS-behavior styled-wrapper primitives: AspectRatio (a pure CSS padding-bottom ratio wrapper), Label (a `for`/`id` association helper), and Progress/ProgressIndicator (ARIA progressbar semantics driven entirely by a `--progress-value` CSS custom property, no timers or DOM APIs). All three ported unmodified from upstream source at the pinned revision (only import paths/doc examples changed from `dioxus_primitives` to `adico_primitives`, matching the pattern already used for separator/tooltip/etc.); none uses `document::eval`, a portal, or any DOM measurement API, so no target-gated adapter work was needed and all three are SSR-safe by construction. Verified for native (SSR-safe default), `--features web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`, and `--features desktop`.
